info.title: Polymath API Service
info.description: Polymath API service to interact with a real or simulated polymath-powered robot

get.summary: Get the version of the Polymath system
get.description: Returns the current Polymath Synapse and polymath_core commit SHAs.

200.description: Polymath Synapse and polymath_core commit SHAs.

get.description: Returns a basic self health status response. This endpoint is used to verify that the Polymath Synapse API is running and responsive.

get.summary: Get the UUID of the Polymath system
get.description: Returns the device UUID derived from its MAC address. Deprecated; use `/health`.

get.summary: Get the combined Autonomy, Navigation and Vehicle feedback from the Polymath system
get.description: Returns combined autonomy, navigation, and vehicle feedback from the Polymath system.

200.description: Combined autonomy, navigation, and vehicle feedback.

get.description: Returns the latest latitude/longitude coordinates for the four corners of the global costmap boundary.

get.summary: Get the available Navigation Path Options and associated Parameters
get.description: Returns available navigation path options and configurable parameters.

200.description: Available navigation path options and parameters.

get.summary: Get the available Vehicle Commands and associated Parameters
get.description: Returns available vehicle command options and configurable parameters.

200.description: Available vehicle command options and parameters.

get.description: Returns available motion commands that can be sent to the Polymath system.

200.description: Available motion command names and numeric alternatives.

get.summary: Get all previously set reference targets
get.description: Returns all previously set reference targets.

post.summary: Set the location and details of a reference location or an object
post.description: Sets one or more reference targets for relative navigation. Each target may include optional `time_validity` and `recorded_speed_m_s` metadata. Use `POST /relative-waypoints` to send waypoints relative to these targets.

200.description: Sent reference targets and upstream service response.

post.summary: Set a reference target at the current robot location
post.description: Creates a `previous_location` reference target from the robot's current GPS pose for subsequent relative navigation.

200.description: Generated current-location reference target and upstream service response.

post.summary: Send a set of gps waypoints to the robot
post.description: Sends GPS waypoints and navigation options to the robot.

200.description: Sent GPS waypoints and upstream service response.

post.summary: Send a set of relative waypoints to the robot
post.description: Sends relative waypoints and navigation options to the robot.

200.description: Sent relative waypoints and upstream service response.

post.summary: Send a motion command to the robot to change its current state
post.description: Sends a motion command to change the robot motion state. Supported commands: `STOP` (0), `PAUSE` (1), and `RESUME` (2).

post.summary: Send a vehicle command to the robot
post.description: Sends a vehicle command to the robot.

200.description: Sent vehicle command and upstream service response.

get.summary: Get the current status of the room
get.description: Returns the current LiveKit room status.

post.summary: Create a livekit room on this robot
post.description: Connects this robot to the specified LiveKit room.

post.summary: Create a track on the current room
post.description: Creates and publishes a track in the current LiveKit room.

400.description: Invalid track request (for example, no room, invalid configuration, or duplicate track name)

delete.summary: Delete a track from the current room
delete.description: Deletes a track from the current LiveKit room.

400.description: Invalid track delete request (for example, no room or track does not exist)

get.summary: Get the list of available CAN interfaces on the system
get.description: Returns available CAN interfaces on the system.

Forwards all requests under /v2/systemd/* to the systemd API service

E.g. to list user services, send a GET request to: `/v2/systemd/list/user`

ControlResponse.description: Model for successful responses in the control API

path_option.title: Path Option
path_option.description: Navigation path logic option to set. See the GET /navigation-path-options endpoint for the available path options and their parameters.

mode.description: Mode of execution of previous and current waypoints. Available options: 'ADD','PREEMPT'. ADD or 0: Add a new waypoint to existing queue of waypoints, PREEMPT or 1: Delete the existing queue and adds the new waypoint.

timestamp_utc.title: Timestamp Utc
timestamp_utc.description: Timestamp in UTC ISO format. Should be provided in ISO 8601 format: 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. If not provided, it will default to the current UTC time.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: Ordered list of GPS waypoints. When multiple waypoints are provided, the robot navigates through them continuously as a single path rather than stopping discretely at each one.

navigation_options.title: Navigation Options
navigation_options.description: Optional navigation options for this command, including the path logic option and execution mode. See the GET /navigation-path-options endpoint for the available path options and their parameters.

yaw.title: Yaw
yaw.description: Yaw (radians). Robot body frame: x forward, y left, z up; positive yaw is counter-clockwise.

timestamp_utc.description: Timestamp in UTC ISO format. Should be provided in ISO 8601 format: 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. If not provided, it will default to the current UTC time.

LivekitTrack.description: Track information for API responses, including configuration and runtime data.

motion_command.description: Motion command options. STOP (0) will cancel all current and queued navigation or vehicle commands. When in STOP, no new commands will be added to the queue until resumed. PAUSE (1) will pause the current command execution, leaving remaining commands in the queue, and RESUME (2) will resume the paused waypoint execution and place the autonomy state back to IDLE if the queue is empty.

mode.description: Mode of execution of previous and current waypoints. Available options: 'ADD','PREEMPT'. ADD or 0: Add a new waypoint to existing queue of waypoints, PREEMPT or 1: Delete the existing queue and adds the new waypoint.

total_distance_remaining.title: Total Distance Remaining
total_distance_remaining.description: Total remaining distance to the goal, in meters.

navigation_time.title: Navigation Time
navigation_time.description: Elapsed navigation time as a duration (seconds and nanoseconds).

estimated_time_remaining.title: Estimated Time Remaining
estimated_time_remaining.description: Estimated time remaining as a duration (seconds and nanoseconds).

target_id.title: Target Id
target_id.description: Unique name or ID of the reference target

timestamp_utc.description: Timestamp in UTC ISO format. Should be provided in ISO 8601 format: 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. If not provided, it will default to the current UTC time.

time_validity.title: Time Validity
time_validity.description: Time validity in seconds. -1 means forever.

recorded_speed_m_s.title: Recorded Speed M S
recorded_speed_m_s.description: Recorded speed of the object in m/s. `None` indicates no measurement available.

timestamp_utc.title: Timestamp Utc
timestamp_utc.description: Timestamp in UTC ISO format. Should be provided in ISO 8601 format: 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. If not provided, it will default to the current UTC time.

x.title: X
x.description: Offset distance in meters along the X axis.

y.title: Y
y.description: Offset distance in meters along the Y axis.

z.title: Z
z.description: Offset distance in meters along the Z axis.

yaw.title: Yaw
yaw.description: Yaw (radians) angular offset indicating the direction the robot should face relative to the target.

relative_to.title: Relative To
relative_to.description: The target that waypoints are specified relative to. Accepts either a name as string or a fully specified ReferenceTarget. The name can be 'current_position', a previously set ReferenceTarget, or the name of a frame in the transform tree, such as 'base_link'. Unknown strings are passed through verbatim and will fail downstream if the reference does not exist. Defaults to 'current_position' so waypoints are interpreted relative to the robot's current pose.

timestamp_utc.title: Timestamp Utc
timestamp_utc.description: Timestamp in UTC ISO format. Should be provided in ISO 8601 format: 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. If not provided, it will default to the current UTC time.

move_to.title: Move To
move_to.description: Ordered list of relative waypoints. When multiple waypoints are provided, the robot navigates through them continuously as a single path rather than stopping discretely at each one. Robot body frame: x forward, y left, z up; positive yaw is counter-clockwise.

navigation_options.title: Navigation Options
navigation_options.description: Optional navigation options for this command, including the path logic option and execution mode. See the GET /navigation-path-options endpoint for the available path options and their parameters.

to.title: To
to.description: User ID to transfer lease to
